title: Test self-attributed to PR #99 r2 rides this crisis-desat diff
evidence:
+@(test)
+route_tie_inline_load_default_is_pinned :: proc(t: ^testing.T) {
+	// PR #99 r2 W3 (the Perkins mutation-proven coverage gap): the inline
+	// jcol default for route_tie on the STRIPPED-JSON load path had ZERO
+	// coverage — reverting the default to amber left 83/83 GREEN, vacuous.
detail: Test self-attributes to PR #99 r2 W3 (route_tie palette default) — unrelated to this diff's crisis-desat purpose; no palette.odin change ships here. Likely stacked-branch or diff-base contamination.

title: Purity contract bullet contradicted by the v.reduced_motion read
evidence:
+// - RENDER-SIDE ONLY, pure derivation: the factor is a pure function of
+//   (crisis rows, tick) — NO app-fed View state (unlike the gauges, the
+//   harness capture path must render it: crisis goldens carry the desat).
...
+	if v.reduced_motion {
+		return 1
+	}
detail: Contract bullet claims the factor is a pure function of (crisis rows, tick) with NO app-fed View state, but the proc reads v.reduced_motion — a third input the bullet omits.
recommended_fix: Amend the contract bullet to '(crisis rows, tick, reduced_motion flag)' or thread reduced_motion as an explicit parameter.

title: Palcheck section 7 clobbers view.reduced_motion without restore
evidence:
+		sv_scale, sv_laned := view.scale, view.lane_detail
+		sv_ox, sv_oy := view.off_x, view.off_y
+		defer {
+			view.scale = sv_scale
+			view.lane_detail = sv_laned
+			view.off_x = sv_ox
+			view.off_y = sv_oy
+		}
...
+		view.reduced_motion = false
detail: Section 7 saves/restores scale, lane_detail and offsets via defer but forces view.reduced_motion=false at start and end without restoring — asymmetric; clobbers any prior caller setting.
recommended_fix: Add reduced_motion to the saved/restored set in the defer block.

title: scan_col never bounds-checks cx before indexing the pixel buffer
detail: scan_col indexes px[... + cx] guarding only yi; cx is never bounds-checked while sibling scan_box checks both axes — an off-screen cx reads out of bounds.
recommended_fix: Mirror scan_box's guard: bounds-check cx against img.width before indexing.

title: Basis-switch pin cannot exhibit the dip it claims to pin
evidence:
+	cr3: pp.Crisis_State
+	defer delete(cr3.active)
+	append(&cr3.active, pp.Active_Crisis{kind = .Saturated_Bundle, bundle_lo = 5, bundle_hi = 6, triggered_tick = 500})
+	table3 := CRISIS_FADE16
+	testing.expect(t, crisis_desat_factor(&v, &cr3, 507) == table3[7], "after the earliest resolves, the basis is the surviving onset (its own phase)")
detail: Single-row fixture (onset 500, tick 507) reads the ordinary ramp entry; with one active row the described overlap-resolution dip and earliest-vs-latest basis are indistinguishable — documentation, not a distinguishing pin.
recommended_fix: Drop the 'after the earliest resolves' framing or acknowledge in the comment that the state-based pin cannot distinguish the semantics.
